items.name: a miniature gold-washed steel ox with long curving horns
items.tap: a miniature gold-washed steel ox with long curving horns
items.description: Shimmering softly in the available light, streaks of dark gold glitter accentuate the bovine's stocky, muscular frame.  Long tapered horns jut out from either side of his broad, triangular face, before arcing upwards into sharp points.  A rough-hewn single-yoked harness, strung with tiny copper sun-shaped discs, hangs around the oxen's thick neck, fastened into place with strips of cream-hued fabric.
